value.rationale: After the known minimum size and threshold, a natural and structurally meaningful unanswered question is to enumerate and classify *all* minimum profile witnesses of this canonical linear-hypothesis class. The theorem gives a single affine orbit of exactly 317,440 minimum bases, its precise stabilizer, and two inequivalent one-repeat extensions, separated by an explicit affine-plane invariant. Thus it completely identifies the symmetries and extremal witness types rather than recomputing the known minimum, which is useful for symmetry reductions in extremal shattering enumerations. No downstream theorem is required for the value of this exact finite classification.
